title: Review budgets, results, profiles and public API predicates
goal: Freeze result categories and scope sufficient to state all core and later runtime theorems.
acceptance_criteria: Accepted, InvalidSyntax, ProfileRejected, LimitExceeded, Unsupported and InfrastructureFailure have disjoint documented meanings.
WellFormed AST and budget sufficiency are defined independently of parser/serializer completion.
Scalar/duplicate/number policies, signed-zero/range decisions and returned-result resource operations are explicit; concrete defaults need human selection.
human_review: Semantic and security review of defaults, rejection reasons and resource-model limits
scope_rule: Only explicitly sealed artifact/file scope; meaning, checker, workflow, release and reporting changes require dedicated independent human review.
null_binding_reason: Candidate project source exists, but this template's task-specific reviewed target, dependency and acceptance identities are not sealed; the applicable manual-review policy or qualified validator must be frozen before any live claim.
